name: emw-missalignment
label: MissAlignment
help:
Wrapper to run miss-alignment for tilt-series alignment improvement. 

*REFERENCES*:
[[https://github.com/warpem/miss-alignment/tree/main][miss-alignment]]

params.name: input_tiltseries
params.label: Input tilt series (STAR):
params.help: STAR file with input tilt-series

params.name: mode
params.label: Mode
params.help: Select the mode of operation for the denoising process. Train and inference by default. Train only will train a model without performing inference. Infer only will use an existing model to denoise tomograms.

params.name: train.n_training
params.label: Training set size:
params.help: Number of tilt series to use for training.

params.name: train.yml.apply_ctf
params.label: Apply CTF correction:
params.help: (apply_ctf) Apply CTF correction during training. Leave False; enabling CTF doubles processing time with no benefit to alignment

params.name: train.yml.iterations_anchoring
params.label: Number of anchoring iterations:
params.help: iteration_setting: Determines the number of anchoring iterations (iterative).

params.name: train.yml.iterations_global
params.label: Number of global iterations:
params.help: iteration_setting: Determines the number of global iterations (single pass).

params.name: train.yml.iterations_spline
params.label: Number of spline iterations:
params.help: iteration_setting: Determines the number of spline/local refinements iterations (coarse-to-fine).

params.name: train.yml.learning_rate
params.label: Learning rate:
params.help: model_training (learning_rate): Learning rate for the optimizer.

params.name: train.yml.max_epochs_per_iteration
params.label: Max epochs per iteration:
params.help: model_training (max_epochs_per_iteration): Determines the maximum number of epochs per iteration.

params.name: train.yml.dt_batch_size
params.label: Data Loading Batch size:
params.help: data_loading (batch_size): Batch size for training.

params.name: train.yml.dt_patch_size
params.label: Data Loading Patch size:
params.help: data_loading (patch_size): Size of patches for training.

params.name: train.yml.dt_steps_per_epoch
params.label: Data Loading Steps per epoch:
params.help: data_loading (steps_per_epoch): Number of steps per epoch.

params.name: train.yml.al_patch_size
params.label: Alignment Patch size:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (patch_size): Same as training.

params.name: train.yml.al_batch_size
params.label: Alignment Batch size:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (batch_size): Batch size for training.

params.name: train.yml.al_patch_overlap
params.label: Patch overlap:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (patch_overlap): tolerated overlap between patches used for optimizing the alignment.

params.name: train.missalign.dataloaders-per-trainer
params.label: Number of data loader per trainer:
params.help: (--dataloaders-per-trainer) Number of CPU DataLoader workers per training device. Total DataLoader workers = this value × number of training devices. [default: 2]

params.name: train.missalign.prepare-stacks
params.label: Prepare stacks (A):
params.help: (--prepare-stacks) Pixel size (in Angstroms) for preprocessing tilt stacks. If provided, loads raw tilt images, rescales to this pixel size, and creates tilt stacks with thumbnails before training.

params.name: train.missalign.start-at-iteration
params.label: Start at iteration:
params.help: (--start-at-iteration) If the run is interrupted, it can be resumed at any iteration with --start-at-iteration N (counting from 0).

params.name: infer.model_run_directory
params.label: Training run directory:
params.help: Finished Miss-Alignment training run containing iter1/model.ckpt ... iterN/model.ckpt. Required for Infer only mode. In Train & Infer mode, the training directory produced by the current job will be used automatically.

params.name: infer.yml.apply_ctf
params.label: Apply CTF correction:
params.help: (apply_ctf) Apply CTF correction during alignment. Leave False; enabling CTF approximately doubles processing time.

params.name: infer.yml.iterations_anchoring
params.label: Number of anchoring iterations:
params.help: Number of anchoring iterations to apply. The number and order of inference iterations must not exceed the models available in the selected training run.

params.name: infer.yml.iterations_global
params.label: Number of global iterations:
params.help: Number of global alignment iterations to apply.

params.name: infer.yml.iterations_spline
params.label: Number of local/spline iterations:
params.help: Number of local refinement iterations using alignment: [3, 3].

params.name: infer.yml.al_patch_size
params.label: Alignment Patch size:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (patch_size): Patch size used during alignment. Normally this should match the value used during training.

params.name: infer.yml.al_batch_size
params.label: Alignment Batch size:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (batch_size): Number of patches reconstructed simultaneously. Reduce for GPUs with less memory.

params.name: infer.yml.al_patch_overlap
params.label: Patch overlap:
params.help: tilt_series_alignment (patch_overlap): Tolerated overlap between patches used for alignment optimization.

params.name: infer.missalign.prepare-stacks
params.label: Prepare stacks (A):
params.help: (--prepare-stacks) Pixel size in Angstroms used when preparing the tilt stacks before inference.

params.name: infer.missalign.start-at-iteration
params.label: Start at iteration:
params.help: (--start-at-iteration) Resume inference from this iteration. Iterations are counted from 0.

params.name: gpus
params.label: GPUs
params.help: If it is a single number (N), it will represent the total number of GPUs (0..N-1). It there are multiple values, it will be the specific GPUs ID.

params.name: cpus
params.label: CPUs
params.help: If empty, the program will use the number of GPUs * 10 CPUs.

params.label: Launchers
params.help: Launchers to use for the different programs

params.name: launcher_missalignment
params.label: Missalignment
params.help: Launcher to use for Miss-alignment
